versions.changelog:
- Added direct links to official CoinW API documentation for each endpoint in the Quick Reference tables.
- Each API operation in the Market Information, Place Orders, Query Orders, and Account Information sections now includes a "Detailed Doc URL" column pointing to its reference on coinw.com.
- No changes to the skill functionality or endpoints; documentation enhancement only.

- Bumped version to 1.5.0.
- Added a clear note that Coinw Spot endpoints require Spot MD5 uppercase signing and not Contract HMAC-SHA256 signing.
- No other content or functional changes detected.

- Added OpenClaw credential requirements to SKILL.md metadata for improved secure credential storage and detection.
- Updated setup instructions to clarify that secrets provided in chat will be stored securely via OpenClaw, not inside markdown files.
- Minor wording and formatting adjustments for clarity in credential setup and usage documentation.

- Added a "Quick Start" section with clear instructions for setting up CoinW API credentials (via environment variables or agent-directed flow).
- Included security guidance on credential handling and masking, advising users not to paste secrets into public prompts.
- No changes to API endpoints, features, or core documentation content.
